resolved_incompatibility.problem: The extractor explicitly preserved same-coordinate London-authority overlap aliases for one HMLR INSPIRE identity, while the prior resume registry validator rejected every repeated INSPIRE identity.
resolved_incompatibility.risk: A valid real extraction could exit successfully and then be incorrectly rejected by resumable post-validation.
resolved_incompatibility.resolution: 027_validate_resumable_alias_safe.py replaces only the registry identity rule and delegates all other source, raster, measurement and publication gates to 025.

conditions: all repeated rows have one canonical_primary_row_no
all repeated rows have identical source longitude and latitude within 1e-7
an in-shard primary is present and marked authority_overlap_primary when the primary row lies in the shard

rejected_conditions: repeated INSPIRE identity containing unique status
official_identity_note: HMLR INSPIRE ID remains the official polygon identity; authority-overlap aliases are canonical compatibility rows and do not create a second official parcel identity.
